'''Shellava''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|living]], rogue [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]. It produced a crisp, tight-skinned [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was also referred to as "shellava."<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
